skills.name: Motion graphs
skills.description: Reading position, velocity, and acceleration from position-time and velocity-time graphs.
question_forms: read the velocity or acceleration off a motion graph
determine displacement from the area under a velocity-time graph

skills.name: Kinematic equations
skills.description: Applying the constant-acceleration equations to solve for position, velocity, or time.
question_forms: solve for an unknown kinematic quantity given constant acceleration
find the time or distance for a free-falling object

skills.name: Vector components
skills.description: Resolving a vector into perpendicular components using sine and cosine.
question_forms: resolve a vector into its x and y components
find the magnitude and direction of a vector from its components

skills.name: Vector addition
skills.description: Combining vectors by adding components, including for displacement and velocity.
question_forms: find the resultant of two or more vectors by adding components
determine a relative velocity by vector addition

skills.name: Newton's laws
skills.description: Applying F = ma to a free-body diagram to find net force or acceleration, often combined with kinematics to solve for motion.
question_forms: draw a free-body diagram and find the net force or acceleration
solve for tension or acceleration in a system of connected objects

skills.name: Friction
skills.description: Incorporating static and kinetic friction forces into a force analysis, including resolving the normal force into components on an incline.
question_forms: find the friction force or acceleration of an object on a surface
analyze the forces on an object on an inclined plane with friction

skills.name: Circular motion
skills.description: Applying centripetal force and acceleration to objects moving along a curved path.
question_forms: find the centripetal force or acceleration for an object in circular motion
solve for the speed or radius of an object on a banked or level curve

skills.name: Work
skills.description: Computing the work done by a force, including cases where force and displacement are not parallel.
question_forms: compute the work done by a force acting at an angle to displacement
apply the work-energy theorem to find a speed or force

skills.name: Conservation of energy
skills.description: Tracking kinetic and potential energy through a system where mechanical energy is conserved.
question_forms: use conservation of mechanical energy to find a speed or height
track energy transformations through a system

skills.name: Conservation of momentum
skills.description: Applying conservation of momentum, a vector quantity, to a system of interacting objects.
question_forms: apply conservation of momentum to find an unknown velocity or mass
compute the impulse delivered to an object

skills.name: Collisions
skills.description: Distinguishing elastic from inelastic collisions by checking whether kinetic energy is conserved, then solving for post-collision velocities.
question_forms: determine whether a collision is elastic or inelastic and solve for velocities
find the final velocity in a perfectly inelastic collision

skills.name: Torque
skills.description: Computing torque about a pivot and applying rotational equilibrium.
question_forms: compute the torque produced by a force about a pivot
find an unknown force or distance using rotational equilibrium

skills.name: Angular momentum
skills.description: Applying conservation of angular momentum to a rotating system.
question_forms: apply conservation of angular momentum to find a change in rotational speed
compute the angular momentum of a rotating object

skills.name: Orbital motion
skills.description: Combining gravitation with circular motion, energy conservation, and Kepler's second law (conservation of angular momentum) to describe orbits.
question_forms: find the orbital speed or period of a satellite or planet
apply energy conservation or Kepler's second law to an orbiting body
